_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. model sheet of a stocky man in his late twenties in a black rubber fisherman's apron over a red plaid flannel with the sleeves pushed up, a backwards cap, thick forearms; front, profile, behind-a-counter pose, kneeling-to-a-dog pose; expression heads: grin, careful, steady, delighted; labeled GULLY 2006. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, watermark, extra fingers
